subject: 10-bit decode output = MT2T (V4L2_PIX_FMT_MT2110T)
body: HEVC Main10 and VP9 profile 2 sessions on the PC report vsi.pic.fourcc MT2T with fb_sz = 1.25 x the 8-bit MM21 size (320x256: Y 102400, C 51200): 8-bit MM21-style tiles plus the 2 low bits stored separately. n2_mm21 and the protocol (N2VCD_OPEN_FMT_MM21 only) cannot carry it yet; needed for HDR/10-bit playback and the VT decoder. Clips: gpu/hwcodec/fmt/streams/f320-hevc10.h265, f320-vp9p2.ivf (fmt/run_fmt.sh shows the session).
